# poweradmin_zone_template (Resource)

Manages a zone template in Poweradmin. Zone templates are reusable sets of DNS records that can be applied when creating new zones. Requires Poweradmin 4.2.0+.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Define a reusable zone template
resource "poweradmin_zone_template" "default" {
  name        = "default-hosting"
  description = "Default record set for hosting customers"
}

# A global template (visible to all users) — requires ueberuser permission
resource "poweradmin_zone_template" "global" {
  name        = "company-wide"
  description = "Mandatory records for every internal zone"
  is_global   = true
}

# Share a template with user groups (Poweradmin 4.6.0+); members can then use it
resource "poweradmin_zone_template" "shared" {
  name        = "team-hosting"
  description = "Hosting records the ops team can reuse"
  groups      = [3, 4]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `description` (String) Description of the zone template
- `name` (String) Name of the zone template (must be unique)

### Optional

- `groups` (Set of Number) IDs of the user groups the template is shared with. Requires Poweradmin 4.6.0+; older versions ignore it with a warning. Leave it out to keep the current shares; set it to replace them, listing every group the template should keep, including ones a super admin added that you cannot remove yourself. The owner can share only with groups they belong to, a super admin with any group, and a global template cannot be shared. A group member who is not the owner must leave it out, as any configured value is refused.
- `is_global` (Boolean) Whether this template is global (visible to all users). Requires ueberuser permission to set true. Defaults to `false` on first create; once set, the value is preserved across applies (toggle it explicitly to change it, since toggling reassigns ownership server-side).

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Unique identifier for the zone template
- `owner` (Number) User ID that owns the template. `0` indicates a global template.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import a zone template by its numeric ID
terraform import poweradmin_zone_template.default 1
```
